Zoya.title: Zoya
project_text_1:
A unique family retreat designed for special private gatherings, relaxation, and rejuvenation was what our client envisioned for their Palm Jumeirah home.

Combining two residences into a single expansive home makes it a distinctive offering for the area. The desired design incorporates a variety of dedicated family social spaces with a strong emphasis on wellness.

Zoya embodies a deep sense of place and tradition, establishing a lasting connection to the Arabian Peninsula and creating a welcoming sanctuary for family bonding and cherished memories. Inspired by the gentle ripples of seawater on the beach, the design incorporates stepped angular terraces that allow for uninterrupted views of the sky. Each terrace is a perfect spot for sunbathing during the day and stargazing at night.
project_text_2: The villa includes a spacious fitness room, steam bath, and a tranquil tea room that overlooks a terrace with a private yoga deck, enhanced by flowing water and an infinity pool, which visually merges with the surrounding sea.

A standout element of Zoya is the contemporary Arabian courtyard and garden integrated into the floor plan. Visible from every ground-floor room, this centuries-old design concept, which naturally cools the building, features an enclosed glass space with sunken seating and a fire table, all centred around a majestic olive tree, fostering a communal atmosphere around the fire.

AUREA.title: AUREA
project_text_1:
Villa Aurea is a luxury beachfront residence located on Palm Jumeirah, Dubai. Originally conceived for a European client, the villa was designed as an exceptional private home while also appealing to the international luxury property market.
The name Aurea, derived from the Latin word for golden, reflects the villa's defining architectural feature: a striking bronze screen façade that wraps the home in warmth, texture, and filtered light. Throughout the day, the bronze screens create a constantly changing play of shadow and sunlight, giving the residence a distinctive identity and an ever-evolving character.

Designed as a contemporary six-bedroom beach house, Villa Aurea embraces the principles of seamless indoor-outdoor living. The open-plan ground floor flows effortlessly towards a long infinity-edge swimming pool, which stretches towards the beach and uninterrupted sea views beyond. Large expanses of glazing dissolve the boundary between interior and exterior spaces, allowing natural light and coastal views to become an integral part of everyday living.
At the heart of the home is a dramatic double-height living space with a nine meter high ceiling. It is a gathering space, creating a sense of openness while framing views across the pool, landscape, and waterfront setting.
project_text_2:
Occupying the entire second floor, the master penthouse suite enjoys complete privacy and panoramic views towards the Palm Jumeirah skyline and Dubai's spectacular sunsets. Inspired by the luxury resorts of Bali, the suite features an outdoor bathroom immersed within lush tropical planting, creating a tranquil sanctuary connected to nature.

A glass-bottom plunge pool acts as both a leisure feature and an architectural element, allowing sunlight to filter through the water and project shimmering reflections onto the terrace below. This movement of light animates the façade and reinforces the villa's connection to water throughout the day.

The villa includes seven generously proportioned bedroom suites. Additional lifestyle amenities include a private gym, cinema room, and a secure garage.

Natural materials play a central role in the architectural language of Villa Aurea. The façade is clad in warm natural travertine, selected for its timeless elegance and its ability to complement both the bronze screens and the soft sandy tones of Palm Jumeirah's beachfront setting.
project_text_3: Visitors enter through a double-height entrance hall framed by a monumental bronze pivot door that echoes the materiality of the exterior screens. A cascading water feature positioned in front of a glazed wall creates a calming soundtrack and a dynamic play of reflected light.

Villa Aurea is a home designed to celebrate light, water, materiality, and the beauty of coastal living, an elegant contemporary sanctuary that embodies the essence of luxury beachfront architecture on Palm Jumeirah.

Athena.title: Athena
project_text_1: Nestled on a hillside near the charming resort town of Porto Cheli, this contemporary luxury villa offers a perfect blend of lush greenery and stunning sea views over the sparkling turquoise Mediterranean.

Designed as a summer retreat that embodies the essence of the Greek lifestyle in a cosmopolitan region renowned for being a beloved family holiday destination, Athena features a thoughtfully organised layout across two levels.
project_text_2: The ground floor houses the entry and master suite, while the lower ground floor accommodates guests, ensuring privacy and comfort. Common areas are strategically positioned to overlook the infinity pool, creating an inviting space for lounging and entertaining against a backdrop of panoramic views. A minimal white roof canopy extends the full length of the villa, providing essential shade from the Mediterranean sun.

Thick stone walls, sourced from local quarries, ground the structure, allowing it to blend into the seemingly untouched hillside, enhancing the villa's natural aesthetic while offering a luxurious escape in this idyllic setting.

Onyx.title: Onyx
project_text_1: Seeking modern luxury, our client envisioned a hillside villa overlooking breathtaking views of Freetown for their family. Our design objective was to create an open-plan living retreat that prioritised beautifully designed outdoor living spaces for family enjoyment and guest entertainment yet seamlessly integrated private and service areas for discreet operation.

Adding to the villa's refined aesthetic, Onyx's façade design draws inspiration from flowing, organic curves reminiscent of a yacht's silhouette, embellished with GRP panels, travertine, white aluminium and timber louvres for privacy. The entrance is marked by a triple-height back-lit Onyx Sky Door, setting a tone of grandeur.
project_text_2:
Inside, the villa features expansive living areas that flow effortlessly, creating a sense of openness and light. The master suite serves as a serene retreat with panoramic views, whilst the remaining ensuite bedrooms offer luxurious comfort and privacy.

With outdoor living a desired focal point, a spacious infinity pool featuring star-like lighting, floating daybeds, and a large jacuzzi creates a serene setting that enhances relaxation and entertainment, providing a seamless connection to the natural surroundings.
The Onyx project elevates the client's lifestyle by blending aesthetics, comfort, and functionality, creating a safe, secluded home that exudes luxury and sophistication.

Moya.title: Moya
project_text_1: Positioned within Emirates Hills, one of Dubai’s most exclusive enclaves, Moya was conceived in response to a client’s need for a landmark residence that appealed to discerning buyers seeking both sophistication and comfort. It was important to create a residence that supported both everyday living and social engagement. Our design philosophy centres on contemporary elegance, wellness and entertainment, ensuring Moya is as functional as it is beautiful, with the privacy of a home and the ambience of a luxury escape.

Fluid, sculptural forms, defined by continuous, curved profiles wrapped around the structure, showcase Moya’s architectural language from arrival. Softened by travertine cladding and engineered bamboo soffits with a water-like texture, the entrance draws guests through double-height bronze doors into a vast central atrium.
project_text_2: Here, natural light floods in, enhancing the interplay of textures and defining the spatial experience, thoughtfully divided into two distinct wings; a clear separation of social and private spaces, both oriented towards expansive landscaped green views of Montgomerie Golf Club Dubai and the Dubai Marina skyline. Above ground, eight ensuite bedrooms and a penthouse suite offer individual privacy and luxury comforts, whilst below, in the basement, sits an extensive entertainment area prioritising wellness and leisure, with spa and salon treatment rooms, a gym, and a state-of-the-art 12-seater cinema and golf simulator

A secluded sunken garden brings daylight deep into the villa, creating a strong connection to nature, further elevated by moving outside to an infinity pool overlooking the golf course, with lush gardens and terraces designed for alfresco dining and relaxation.
Moya brings together architectural innovation, refined materials and resort-style amenities in a considered balance, where design, function and experience aligned to support contemporary family living.

Vaya.title: Vaya
project_text_1: The interplay of engineering and precision is vital in the world of motorsport. For our client, a professional race car driver, these elements were crucial to transforming his Palm Jumeirah villa into a modern sanctuary. Radiating luxury and sophistication, this distinguished villa offers an exquisite blend of design, high-quality materials, and exceptional finishes. The renovation embodies sleek contemporary aesthetics, integrating high-quality materials and advanced technology to create a space that mirrors its owner's dynamic lifestyle.

The villa's exterior has been reimagined with modern cladding and expansive glass elements, evoking the aerodynamic profiles of race cars. Inside, the design emphasises fluidity and openness, featuring polished finishes and a minimalist aesthetic. 

The entrance foyer leads to open-plan living areas that seamlessly connect to the streamlined kitchen and private master suite, offering both functionality and luxury.
project_text_2:
The standout feature is the garage, designed as a gallery to showcase the client's prized car collection, blending automotive artistry with architectural design. Vaya incorporates smart home systems for lighting, climate and security, ensuring efficiency and comfort.  

Outdoor living is enhanced with an infinity pool, a roof terrace featuring a floating sky bridge, and a multifunctional area that includes an outdoor kitchen, bar, and a custom fire pit. These spaces provide relaxation and entertainment, perfectly complementing the villa's interior.

With a bold modern aesthetic, Vaya shares both privacy and striking beauty. Perfect for those who appreciate opulence and precision engineering and crave an enchanting living experience that is as advanced and sophisticated as the world of racing.

Skye Residences.title: Skye Residences
project_text_1:
SKYE Residences embodies our commitment to crafting elegant homes that cater to the diverse needs of modern city dwellers. Our client had a vision to create a sophisticated urban living experience in the heart of Dubai.

SKYE Residences' design prioritises natural light and city views, incorporating floor-to-ceiling windows and open balconies to connect residents with the vibrant surroundings. The sleek exterior features a blend of glass and steel, complemented by lush greenery to create a serene urban oasis.

Inside, residents are welcomed by a stylish lobby with contemporary art installations and a concierge service. The open-plan apartments are designed for comfort and functionality, with high-end finishes and smart home technology. Each unit offers spacious living areas, modern kitchens, and luxurious bathrooms, with the penthouses providing expansive terraces and breathtaking views of Burj Khalifa and Dubai Fountain.
project_text_2: Outdoor amenities include a landscaped garden, a rooftop infinity pool, and a state-of-the-art fitness centre. The communal spaces are designed for social interaction, with lounges, a co-working area, and a children's play zone.

SKYE Residences not only elevates the standard of urban living but also enhances the lifestyle of its residents, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a dynamic and luxurious home in Downtown Dubai.
project_type_set: 20 x 1 Bedroom Apartments</br>15 x 2 Bedroom Apartments</br>5 x 3 Bedroom Apartments

Sonia.title: Sonia
project_text_1:
A majestic Adansonia tree stood as the pivotal inspiration for our client, a seasoned developer on the Palm Jumeirah, to transform a Mediterranean villa into a contemporary masterpiece that would appeal to European buyers.

Framed by an 8m high glass guillotine system that opens vertically, the Baobab creates a striking focal point, drawing guests in from the characteristic natural palette exterior with travertine stone cladding and teak soffits that evoke the essence of driftwood. Featuring angular designs throughout, including towering 11-meter-high walls connected by expansive glazing, Sonia boasts a modern aesthetic with materials like stone cladding, aluminium profiles, and custom-made angled window frames.

Upon arrival, a 5m high Vitrocsa Pivot Door partnered with a unique sunscreen mesh seamlessly blends with the interior's hardwood teak cladding, welcoming you into the double-height atrium, bathed in natural light from the glass-bottomed roof pool, creating a shimmering effect throughout the foyer.

The formal and family rooms create an ample, versatile space, with versatile furniture designating functional areas for social and lounge uses. The second floor boasts a 'T-shaped' infinity pool with a glass floor, enhancing the atrium's luminosity.
project_text_2: Outdoor living is elevated with a 20-meter infinity pool featuring sunken seating and a swim-up bar. Elevated gardens on the first-floor balconies provide lush, shaded retreats, while the second floor offers an entertainment lounge and gym with views of the Atlantis Hotel & Resort.

This transformation seamlessly blends elegance, comfort, and functionality, not only enhancing Sonia's aesthetic appeal but also elevating the European-style lifestyle of those who will make this their home away from home.

Lumeria.title: Lumeria
project_text_1: Lumeria is a seven-bedroom villa set on the waterfront, its scale immediately apparent on approach. Behind that scale lies a more intimate ambition: to offer an escape from the relentless pace of city life, a house shaped as much by quiet as by grandeur.

The entrance sets the tone. A double-height hall rises through the centre of the plan, crossed by a chandelier that falls through the space like strands of illuminated glass. Rather than spectacle for its own sake, the light is used to draw the eye between levels, giving coherence to what could otherwise be an overwhelming volume.
project_text_2: Moving deeper into the house, the architecture softens. Living spaces are arranged around framed views of the water, with quiet corners set aside for reading and reflection, while the kitchen and a long dining room are made for the everyday rituals of family life.

Throughout, the craft is exacting. Timber panels are aligned with near-obsessive precision, storage disappears into the walls, and stone surfaces, delicate screens, soft fabrics and bespoke furniture are composed as parts of one continuous interior. Even the lighting is absorbed into the architecture, grazing surfaces to reveal their texture rather than drawing attention to itself.
project_text_3: For all its scale, Lumeria remains remarkably calm – monumental yet warm, highly refined yet comfortable, dramatic in its architecture but gentle in the way it is lived. That balance may be its greatest achievement: not simply a refuge from the city, but an entirely different rhythm of life, shaped by water, natural light, material warmth and the quiet confidence of exceptional craftsmanship.

Maelis.title: Maelis
project_text_1: Our client wanted a villa on the frond of Palm Jumeirah that would stand apart from its neighbours. But the request that really shaped the plan was a quieter one. This is a household where hosting is a practice, not an occasion. Large gatherings. Catered functions. Guests who stay.

Houses that receive at this scale usually pay for it in atmosphere. Service corridors. Staging space. The work of hospitality turning up in the room. At Maelis we designed it out of sight. The formal reception was built to hold large catered functions, with bespoke casework that conceals the service routes. Guests see the evening. Never the effort behind it
project_text_2: The design then began by deciding what would not move. Mature palms already stood on the plot, and they stayed. We drew the house around them and held it back from the boundaries it could have claimed, so the garden would remain the larger presence. Every principal room looks along a single line: from the double-height entry hall, through the planting, across an infinity pool that runs nearly the full rear boundary, out to the sea.

Arched openings carry the façade, cut in natural stone with tapered sculptural finishes. The rhythm is slow and regular. It reads closer to a colonnade in a walled garden than to a villa on a waterfront. The reference is the classical palatial garden, where architecture existed to frame cultivated ground. The grand double-height entry sits within that same rhythm and resolves in a bespoke arched glass skydoor.
project_text_3:
A slender arched bridge crosses the pool to the beach. A yoga terrace sits among the planting. The terraces were drawn without dead ends, so guests move through the grounds in a continuous loop and never arrive at a wall.
Maelis stands apart for what we left out, and for what was already here and kept.

MILA.title: MILA
project_text_1: Desiring a harmonious connection and coexistence with nature, our client envisioned a distinguished family home that embodied the principles of biophilia and prioritised wellness. Across its four levels, Mila effortlessly combines the functionality of a spacious, open-plan family home with the versatility to host large gatherings and emphasise modern indoor-outdoor living.

From the outside, Mila's entrance is marked by a triple-height glass feature and a 7.1-meter teak sky door, anchoring sleek, yacht-like curves that inspired its façade; flared white edges, designed to maximise natural light while offering sun protection. Large timber louvres and extended overhangs ensure a cool interior environment during intense summer months.
project_text_2: Inside, an aesthetic and atmosphere that is open and inviting, living areas have been oriented to capture views of Burj Al Arab. Design highlights include a spacious penthouse master suite and multiple balconies with planters, enhancing the connection to nature.

Outdoor, set around a stunning cantilevered glass-bottom pool, spaces are designed for relaxation and entertainment, with lush gardens and terraces that remain functional in the desert climate.

This project elevates the client's lifestyle by blending aesthetics, comfort, and functionality, creating a sanctuary that harmoniously integrates with the natural surroundings.

Atelier.title: Atelier
project_text_1: Leaning into the shift in modern retail towards guest experience and closed brand connection, our client, an emerging high-fashion entrepreneur, sought to create an atelier that felt transparent, understated, and centred entirely on celebrating their haute couture collection. For Atelier, our architectural response was guided by restraint, with a clear objective to express luxury without excess through materiality and refinement through precision in design and detailing.

More than a conventional retail space, Atelier acts as a metaphorical frame encasing the collection, allowing each piece to remain in focus without competing with its surroundings. Within, the experience is designed to feel seamless and immersive, drawing attention to craft, detail and artistry.
project_text_2: Reinforcing the importance of content over context, the physical space serves as a considered backdrop. Defined by openness and clarity, expansive glass façades create visual continuity throughout, allowing natural light to illuminate the collection. Interior material choices were carefully considered to align with the brand’s identity. Travertine introduces a tactile warmth, while polished bronze adds a layer of refinement and soft reflectivity. Seemingly small, subtle touches, together, they create a palette that feels luxurious yet grounded, enhancing the garments without distraction.

Through a considered approach to a seamless retail experience within an environment truly reflective of its artist, Atlier’s atmosphere elevates the perception of the brand and allows the couture to remain the true focal point as initially intended.

Miraia.title: Miraia
project_text_1: Our client's brief for Miraia was direct in its ambition. A spectacular, contemporary residence, one built to outlast the island's own evolution. As Palm Jebel Ali grew from a construction site into a fully realized community, the villa needed to remain just as relevant. The name itself carries that intention. Miraia draws from the Latin mirari, to wonder at, paired with a soft, feminine "aia" that echoes waves, air, a passing breeze.

The design's central narrative reaches further back than the brief itself, into the region's own history. Miraia reinterprets the Falaj, the ancient UAE water channel system that once carried life through arid land. Here, it becomes a living architectural device. Water threads through the villa as a continuous line, connecting indoor and outdoor spaces the way the Falaj once connected communities to survival.
project_text_2: The brief called for two lives under one roof: a grand formal wing built to host large-scale events and guests, and a smaller, clearly separated family wing for daily life. We resolved this by organizing Miraia into two distinct wings, unified along a central axis that opens into a large sunken courtyard.

Partially recessing the building into the lower ground lets it draw daylight and sightlines down into the basement. Spa, gym, and entertainment spaces that would otherwise sit underground and unlit are pulled into the light. Eight bedrooms and a full lower level become naturally bright, inhabited rooms, not back-of-house space.
project_text_3: Above ground, the architectural language began in clean, linear forms, aligned with Nakheel's masterplan guidelines. Level by level, these forms softened into the undulating profiles of waves and current. The shift became the villa's own quiet argument for calm.

Deep terraces, shaded courtyards, and high-performance glazing were built in from the start, not added later.
Miraia is built to be lived in for decades, not admired for a season, a residence that grows more relevant, not less, as the island around it does the same.

Soul.title: Soul
project_text_1: With an emphasis on wellness and rejuvenation, Soul is a sanctuary that seamlessly integrates nature into its architecture and ethos, designed to provide a serene escape from city life.

Upon entering Soul, cosily nestled on La Mer South Island, through its double-height foyer, our clients are greeted by a lush garden that runs alongside the atrium, inviting light and greenery into the central spaces. The ground floor features an open-plan living area with a show kitchen at its heart, promoting a sense of togetherness and comfort.
project_text_2: The lower ground floor is dedicated to well-being, housing a gym, spa, sauna, and ice bath. An outdoor sunken garden enhances relaxation with a plunge pool, complemented by a cantilevered pool above, emphasizing the interplay of water at various levels. The crowning feature is the roof terrace, showcasing a glass floor sky pool that allows light to cascade below.
Offering breathtaking views of the sea and city skyline, this tranquil space encourages families to unwind and recharge away from the hustle and bustle of urban life.

Ayla.title: Ayla
project_text_1: Situated in the esteemed Emirates Hills community, our client, a large multigenerational family, sought to transform their cherished villa into a modern sanctuary that honours its historical essence while embracing contemporary living.This modern villa design now masterfully combines sophistication with natural warmth, reflecting our commitment to creating a home that balances tradition with innovation, catering to the diverse needs of a family spanning several generations.

The striking design features clean lines and expansive glass façades, complemented by elegant timber wood elements that add a rich, organic texture to the exterior. Ayla's exterior has been rejuvenated with a blend of natural travertine stone, composite bamboo elements that complement the villa's original charm, and a newly integrated façade system painted white to evoke a sense of lightness. The entrance is marked by custom-cast in-situ concrete fins, offering a signature look that integrates with the surroundings.
project_text_2: The interior is a testament to timeless elegance, with clean lines and natural materials that bridge the past and present. The design prioritises accessibility and flow, featuring universal design principles to accommodate ageing family members. Large sliding doors open communal spaces, enhancing social interaction while maintaining intimate private areas. Outdoor living is reimagined with a contemporary pool, aluminium pergolas, and lush gardens that extend the living space into nature. These elements create an instant indoor-outdoor connection, fostering a calming environment of escape or entertainment.

Sustainability is at the core of this renovation, with discreetly integrated solar panels and rainwater harvesting systems. Eco-friendly materials ensure the villa remains environmentally responsible, enhancing comfort without compromising its aesthetic appeal.

Ensuring the villa serves as a cherished home for generations to come, Ayla embodies a perfect balance of contemporary style and natural harmony that can withstand the test of time, a serene retreat in the heart of Dubai.

W44.title: W44
project_text_1: Driven by an ambitious, forward-thinking businessman seeking a high-end retail showroom, W44 & Saint Etrenne was briefed to reflect both the client’s entrepreneurial vision and the prestige of the brands he represents. With a strong emphasis on quality, craftsmanship and market positioning, the objective was to move beyond conventional retail into a more elevated, experience-led environment. Particular importance was placed on sophistication and subtlety, favouring a timeless, confident design language that communicates exclusivity and refined taste.

Positioned as a physical embodiment of the brands it houses, we envisioned an environment where architecture, materiality and spatial experience unite to enhance brand value and desirability. The architectural language is intentionally understated, providing a refined backdrop that keeps the product in focus. Clarity and calm sophistication guide the design, supported by a spatial plan that enables fluid guest movement.
project_text_2: Transparency guided the approach. We curated form, material, and lighting to express restrained luxury. The space remains open yet intimate, with no visual competition for the collection. High-end materials like glass, travertine, and polished metals reinforce craftsmanship, complemented by specialised lighting that enhances texture and detail

A defining feature is the façade, composed of large, uninterrupted glass panels that draw in natural light to create a seamless interior-exterior connection and, keeping the collection visible, transform the showroom into a constant curated display. Travertine and polished bronze introduce structural lines, while vertical fins and framing details add depth and rhythm. The contrast between glass, stone and metal establishes the desired contemporary composition, experienced from the outside.
project_text_3: Inside, the refined palette continues, balancing natural textures with precise, reflective finishes to create a layered sense of luxury. Used sparingly and paired with integrated lighting, the detailing ensures every corner feels considered, creating richness without overwhelm with a clear focus on the collection within an atmosphere of quiet sophistication.

Defined by an uncluttered structural expression and refined minimalism, W44 & Saint Etrenne achieves a balance of precision, restraint and thoughtful materiality. The result is a showroom that stands apart with a clear, confident concept and strong alignment with the brand’s identity.

Solari.title: Solari
project_text_1:
Solari sits on a private stretch of Palm Jumeirah, where the sea meets the villa in an uninterrupted line. The house itself becomes a private family's true centre of gravity, the place where their social life actually happens, not a stage for it.
The brief was demanding in one sense, simple in another: six distinct social zones on a single floor, each with its own presence. None could be allowed to fracture the house into a sequence of disconnected showpieces. Our client wanted the ease of a private resort and the character of collectible design. Spaces with meaning. Somewhere you want to take your shoes off and stay.

The answer was found not in scale, but in material. A single continuous shell of cross cut travertine, warm and faintly porous, wraps the ground floor, inlaid throughout with bronze that turns stone into something closer to jewellery. Underfoot, in the entrance hall, a compass rose of marble and bronze is cut and set like marquetry. It is the first sign that this house was made, not manufactured. Above it, illuminated arcs float, drawing the eye forward through the enfilade toward the great room and its beach panorama.
project_text_2: Light, more than any single material, becomes the true architect of mood here. Cognac saddle leather drapes the great room in a soft, continuous line. Amber glass tubes ring the family lounge with a gentler glow. Alabaster discs hover above the family dining table, catching light rather than casting it. Each installation is bespoke. None are purchased ready-made.

Behind these gestures, backlit honey onyx and cast amber glass act as the home's inner hearths, warm sources around which daily life gathers. By night, the house glows entirely from within, without a single cold light source anywhere in its walls. This is the warmth you notice first: not temperature, but light.
project_text_3: Upstairs, the register softens further. A private family lounge at the top of the stair gallery holds the unhurried hours: film nights, books, and tea, that belong to the family alone. The principal suite closes the floor with its own loggia, set aside for the first coffee of the day.

Solari moves to its own rhythm, night after night. Aperitif at the bar. Dinner beside the glowing onyx wall. Digestif in the lounge by the sea. Each evening is distinct. The house itself stays unchanging beneath it.
Solari is made to measure, a home built around how this family actually lives, not staged for how a house is expected to look. Made for life.

Parus.title: Parus
project_text_1: A serene home away from home, Parus was envisioned as a winter escape on Palm Jumeirah for a large, multi-generational family to experience the essence of a holiday in one sanctuary, where they can reconnect, relax, and recharge.

Natural travertine stone cladding, accented with anodised bronze profiles and decorative mesh screens, gives Parus’s exterior façade a striking uplift. Clean lines, refined tones, and textures echo the coastal setting, inviting skyline and sea into the home through expansive glazed panels.
project_text_2: A double-height entrance lobby, anchored by a grand bronze pivot door, sets a tone of understated elegance. Inside, the villa unfolds around a light-filled foyer, where full-height Vitrocsa sliding glass doors frame uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf.

Balancing flexibility and flow, interconnected formal and family spaces are defined by concealed sliding pocket doors, allowing the layout to shift seamlessly between vibrant social zones and personal, private retreats. An upstairs family lounge provides a communal space for relaxation, adjoining six bedrooms, each with private balconies and panoramic vistas.
project_text_3: Outdoor life is at the heart of Parus; a 21-metre infinity pool stretches along the beachfront, blending the boundary between villa and sea. Expansive terraces and landscaped gardens share a series of spaces for dining, lounging, and play.

Designed with family, function and form as priorities, Parus blends refined aesthetics, comfort and adaptability, becoming a home in which contrasting rhythms of family life and family members converge and revel in their own resort-like retreat.

Tela.title: Tela
project_text_1: Conceived as a luxurious and refined beachside sanctuary, Villa Tela was designed for a discerning couple with a cosmopolitan background shaped by years in Dubai. Envisioned as an escape for privacy, relaxation, and effortless entertaining, the villa fuses European sensibility with the serenity of coastal living.

The architectural narrative begins at the façade, where white limestone cladding in an antique finish is paired with woven metal mesh screens by GKD. These elements provide privacy and solar control while giving the villa a distinctive and layered identity. Composite timber soffits and charcoal grey profiles introduce warmth and contrast, while a 5.1-metre full-height glass pivot door forms a dramatic entrance, flooding the foyer with natural light.
project_text_2: Inside, the villa unfolds as a generous open-plan arrangement anchored by a sculptural cantilevered staircase. Expansive living and dining areas flow seamlessly towards the outdoors through slimline sliding glass doors with integrated flush tracks, dissolving boundaries and framing panoramic sea views. Integrated home automation enhances comfort throughout, allowing you to control lighting, climate, and security with ease. The European-style kitchen, complemented by a fully equipped chef-grade back-of-house kitchen, caters to both intimate family meals and grand gatherings.
project_text_3: Balancing elegance with functionality, Villa Tela is a composed coastal retreat where thoughtful design, privacy, and openness coexist in quiet harmony.

Mantara.title: Mantara
project_text_1: Mantara begins with a question: what would a home look like if nature, not architecture, set the rules? Our client desired a home that felt organic, fluid, and genuinely connected to the world beyond its walls. The challenge was to create a six-bedroom villa that took its formal language not from architecture, but from the sea. Mantara is the result: a home whose every curve honours the manta ray, and whose every space is designed to be lived in deeply.

The form is complex. A continuous white high-performance concrete façade flows from exterior to interior without interruption. Its surface is unbroken by sharp transitions or conventional planes. Slimline glazing, generous and precisely considered, draws natural light throughout the home. Motorised solar shade louvres, patterned on the skeleton of the manta ray, offer protection from the Dubai sun while serving as a subtle, ever-present nod to the villa's inspiration.
project_text_2: A double-height entrance, anchored by a forest of slender bronze columns, introduces the home's central philosophy: that nature belongs at the centre, not the periphery. Inside, open-plan spaces blend into one another with almost no walls between them, exactly as our client envisioned. A sculptural staircase commands the interior with quiet drama. A central forest ensures the living experience remains as grounded as it is refined. Working in close collaboration with Orient Crown Engineers, every structural decision was made in service of the form, never at its expense.

Outdoors, a resort-scale bio-design pool extends the landscape with naturalistic ease. The beach dissolves into the property's edge, softening the boundary between the built and the natural. Above, a rooftop pool with a glass floor bathes the levels below in refracted light. The penthouse master suite and adjacent gym look out over open sea, offering a sense of elevation that is both physical and deeply felt.
Mantara is a testament to what becomes possible when architecture surrenders to nature's own design, and when the craft to realise that vision is equal to the ambition behind it.

Dune.title: Dune
project_text_1:
Over time, the functionality of a family home adapts to those who live within it. For Dune, our client, a visionary family man, sought a contemporary villa that would serve as a nurturing home for his family, ready before his eldest daughter embarks on her university journey. 

The design embodies a harmonious blend of modern aesthetics and functional family living, crafted to meet the unique needs of a growing family. The villa's L-shaped open-plan layout strategically places family spaces along the longest wing, ensuring a seamless visual connection to the formal wing.

A striking yet cohesive façade, the exterior showcases natural travertine cladding on the ground floor, complemented by a white insulated render system on the upper floors. Timber-slatted cladding on the first floor and a roof canopy add warmth and a distinct identity to the entrance.
project_text_2: Inside, a spacious double-height entrance opens to a central courtyard garden reminiscent of traditional Arabic courtyards, providing natural cooling. The home features six bedrooms, each designed for comfort and privacy. The upstairs penthouse, with an adjacent gym and family lounge, opens to a large roof terrace with a central jacuzzi, perfect for sunset views.

The villa's forward positioning on the plot creates a large 'cocoon' garden at the rear, ideal for family gatherings and relaxation. Outdoor living is enhanced by an overflow pool and a private office annexe nestled amongst the greenery, offering a serene workspace for those who need a quieter space to focus. 

Dune elevates the family's lifestyle by seamlessly integrating aesthetics, comfort, and functionality, creating a sanctuary that welcomes home those who have flown the nest and remains cherished for years to come.

Zephyr.title: Zephyr
project_text_1:
Answering an open call brief from a social community seeking to revitalise their clubhouse, Nellis Architecture created the Zephyr design concept, turning a well-used, multi-function space into an inviting, warm retreat for its sailing members with an aura of refinement. 
 
Zephyr elevates the club into a state-of-the-art facility, blending modern elegance with exceptional indoor and outdoor spaces. The transformation introduces a vibrant restaurant and bar featuring a stunning glass orangery with bi-fold doors that seamlessly connect the indoors with the outdoors.

The facade is adorned with Kodek Bamboo vertical slats, while a spacious glass atrium foyer would serve as a new connection between adjacent buildings. This double-height atrium, made from structural glass, featured a ceiling of suspended canvas strips that resemble flowing water when stirred by the wind, adding a serene touch to the space.

Outdoor living would be enhanced with a beautiful outdoor kitchen and bar, perfect for alfresco dining. A sunken outdoor restaurant could offer a fresh dining experience, bringing guests closer to the tranquil waters.
project_text_2: A new rooftop level with a distinctive flared white roof profile draws inspiration from the elegant curves of sailing yachts' flared bows seen bobbing on the waters below. The first floor includes chic private event spaces and sleek new offices, complemented by a striking roof supported by columns resembling elegant sailing masts.

This renovation concept would not only preserve the club's historical integrity but also elevate its functionality, offering an understated yet elegant retreat for its diverse range of members and guests.

Miro.title: Miro
project_text_1:
Serving as an urban oasis near the renowned Jumeirah Beach Road, Miro is a stunning modern villa with breathtaking views of the iconic Burj Al Arab designed to attract luxury buyers. 

Miro's L-shaped structure promotes an open-plan living space. Pivoting anodised screens on the front provide a unique identity for the façade, contrasting beautifully with the villa's white exterior while allowing for adaptable shading and privacy from the street. The more private first floor houses the bedrooms, with the primary suite strategically placed at the end of the longer wing.

Upon entering, residents are welcomed by a grand atrium and staircase that creates a sense of volume and space, elegantly blurring the line between formal and family areas and fostering a harmonious flow throughout the home. All rooms are oriented toward the lush garden and an overflow pool, with large panoramic glass sliding doors that allow natural light and the beauty of nature to permeate the interior.
project_text_2: The architectural design incorporates cantilevered balconies and canopies for effective shading, and the garden is strategically positioned to face south. The pinnacle of the villa is the roof terrace, featuring a family lounge and gym that overlooks a spacious terrace with magnificent views of the Jumeirah coastline and Burj Al Arab.

Offering the best of both worlds, Miro is designed to provide privacy and relaxation as a retreat from the hustle of city life, yet its open, adaptable outdoor and rooftop social spaces encourage owners to invite guests to share in its beauty.

Evergreens.title: Evergreens
project_text_1: Hyderabad, situated in central India, boasts a moderate climate and has emerged as one of the fastest-growing tech cities globally. With its proximity to an international airport and excellent road connections, it offers both convenience and a vibrant lifestyle.

Our client's vision was to develop 106 luxury villas as countryside retreats for city dwellers. The project site is particularly beautiful, bordered by a large eucalyptus forest and mango plantations, providing a serene backdrop for the residences. The master plan draws inspiration from the shape of eucalyptus leaves, with villas staggered along a series of elevated roads to guarantee that every home enjoys stunning forest views.
project_text_2:
Each villa is designed in accordance with Vastu Shastra principles, ensuring harmony and balance in its architecture and layout. On the rooftop, a glass infinity pool creates a serene oasis for relaxation and swimming during cool summer evenings.



Beyond the private villas, the wider community is enriched with exquisite restaurants, sports and event spaces, and family guest accommodations, fostering connection while providing all the amenities for a luxurious lifestyle.

Residents will also enjoy access to an exclusive clubhouse reminiscent of a boutique luxury hotel. This project beautifully blends nature, luxury, and tradition, offering an ideal retreat for those looking to escape the bustle of urban life.
project_type_set: A master-planned gated community of luxury villas
3 villa types, each of different size: S, M & L

HARMONIA.title: HARMONIA
project_text_1:
Harmonia brings together three distinct Palm Jumeirah properties, designed to form a cohesive, resort-like luxury residential collection.

Calling for a refined, modern architectural language to run throughout, our client wanted to emphasise timeless quality over excess, with careful consideration of the balance between privacy and openness.

Guided by disciplined restraint, our approach began with a deep understanding of the Palm Jumeirah market and the level of refinement expected. In-depth site and feasibility studies then informed decisions on privacy, orientation, and environmental response, and defined the overarching design concept, language, and material palette.

From there, the focus was on how the homes would be experienced when lived in. Layouts were carefully planned to support both everyday life and a relaxed, resort-style rhythm, with emphasis on circulation, double-height volumes, and indoor-outdoor synergy. By embedding privacy whilst balancing openness in the architecture through massing and layering, we were able to create homes that feel exclusive, protected and discreet, overcoming a common challenge on Palm Jumeirah due to the close proximity of villas.
project_text_3: Every element in our process was intentionally designed to enhance visual depth and climate performance. Harmonia’s aesthetic design draws on texture, light, and landscape, allowing the villas to respond to their surroundings rather than compete with them.  Horizontal forms and layered façades echo the Palm’s natural horizons. Land, sea, and sky-like stratification is expressed through strong slab lines, recessed glazing, and deep overhangs, with materiality in stone tones, weathered timber, and subtle bronze detailing.

Shading strategies and integrated planter systems lend themselves to a climate-responsive composition that reduces solar gain and enhances thermal comfort. Expansive glazing connects interior and exterior spaces, recessed openings and vertical fins provide passive solar control, and integrated planters blur the boundary between built form and nature.

Harmonia is defined by an architecture that feels grounded and tactile, designed as a calm, cohesive collection of homes where architecture, environment and lifestyle come together with clarity, balance and quiet confidence.

Amara.title: Amara
project_text_1:
Villa Amara offers a stunning family retreat, nestled amongst private beaches, pontoons, spacious driveways and a swimming lagoon on the serene Nareel Island in Abu Dhabi.
Designed with exquisite detail, this family home features a striking white limestone façade and an L-shaped layout that enhances both aesthetics and functionality.

Overhanging canopies shade the extensive slimline glazing, which opens fully to blend indoor and outdoor spaces seamlessly. This design choice encourages natural light while maintaining a connection to the lush tropical garden outside.
project_text_2: Inside, the villa has been designed for maximum comfort and elegance, starting with a spacious majlis at the entrance and a private family lounge that offers a cosy retreat with views of the garden. The first floor features two master suites, both facing the open sea, providing stunning vistas and a tranquil atmosphere throughout the home. This level is one of the villa’s standout features, cantilevering over the main overflow pool and providing shade from the Arabian sun while creating a captivating visual element.

The roof level further amplifies sea views, offering a breathtaking perspective of the vibrant city and its surroundings.

Villa Amara embodies the perfect balance of luxury and nature, making it an ideal sanctuary for a family living in a tranquil yet active neighbourhood on the coast in Al Bateen.

Breakwater.title: Breakwater
project_text_1:
For Breakwater, our design challenge was to renovate a unique developer-owned property, transforming it into a luxury residence that meets the standards and needs of today's market.

This villa showcases a stunning travertine-clad façade with light timber accents, highlighted by an impressive double-height recessed entrance cove with a striking 5-meter-high sky door.

Upon entering the foyer, residents are greeted by breathtaking panoramic views of the sea as they then explore the spacious living and dining areas that flow seamlessly onto a generous rear terrace. Here, an infinity pool stretches nearly the entire length of the property, acting as a backdrop for a cosy sunken seating area complete with a fire pit and an outdoor cinema, perfect for gatherings and entertaining.
project_text_2: Inside, Breakwater features a large family TV lounge and an executive study with a private entrance, providing enhanced comfort and convenience. Most of the bedrooms feature private balconies, offering serene retreats for relaxation. On the roof, a versatile multipurpose space provides endless possibilities, making it ideal for a wide range of activities and gatherings.
Breakwater excels in efficient planning and captivating aesthetics, establishing the villa as one of Palm Jumeirah's most remarkable properties.

Cassia.title: Cassia
project_text_1:
Our client, long-time residents of the UAE with their roots firmly established, sought to transform their existing villa ahead of the arrival of their second child and create a spacious haven that accommodates both intimate family moments and grand entertaining. The vision was to enhance the Neo-Classical style with contemporary elegance, creating a home that reflects their sophisticated lifestyle.
The villa's exterior is adorned with off-white travertine, exuding timeless warmth and blending with lush green surroundings.

A striking double-height entrance featuring a large pivot door welcomes guests into a world of refined design. Inside, Cassia boasts 4-meter-high arched pivot windows, framing breathtaking views of the Montgomerie Golf Club. 


The ground floor's open-plan layout features concealed pocket sliding doors, offering flexibility between privacy and openness.
project_text_2:
The design challenge of integrating a new basement was met with a sculptural spiral staircase that seamlessly connects the formal lounge to the entertainment and spa areas below. The addition of a second floor, supported by a steel structure, ensures minimal impact on the existing architecture while providing expansive living space.

Functional and entertainment elements, such as a cinema, spa, basement entertainment lounge, and car lift, cater to the client's desire for elevated luxury. This extends beyond, with a rooftop terrace, accessible from the entertainment room and gaming lounge, offering panoramic views of the golf course and Dubai Marina skyline, perfect for hosting gatherings.

Outside, a sanctuary of serenity soothes with the sounds of water from the waterfall infinity pool cascading into a sunken garden.

Crafted from a selection of hardwearing materials that prioritise durability and low maintenance, Cassia blends modern-day functions and aesthetics to create a home that is both a private retreat for a young, growing family and a social hub to share moments with friends.

Evergreens Hotel.title: Evergreens Hotel
project_text_1: As Phase 2 of the Evergreens masterplan, Evergreens Hotel was envisioned as a seamless extension of both the landscape and the surrounding villa community it serves. Set against the lush backdrop of Hyderabad’s eucalyptus forests, the exotic Evergreens Hotel is a terraced eco-retreat that honours the natural contours of its site.

Guests enter at street level and descend gradually through the property, following a tiered architectural rhythm that mirrors the natural topography and unveils panoramic views of the forests. Designed as a west-facing U-shaped structure, the Hotel cradles a sunken central courtyard anchored by a cascading pool that flows into a T-shaped lap pool.
project_text_2: Built using locally sourced materials and fully Vastu-compliant, the 30-suite hotel champions wellness and sustainability in both its indoor-outdoor design and philosophy. Green gardens weave through the terraces, courtyards, and rooftop bar, creating a tranquil, immersive guest experience.

A dedicated clubhouse bridges the balance between private villa living and hotel hospitality, reinforcing Evergreen Hotel’s identity as a sanctuary for health, community, and conscious living. Amenities include a multipurpose conference room, two restaurants, a gym and spa, indoor and outdoor tennis courts, squash and padel courts, a cinema, a games room, and a rooftop cocktail bar.

Evia.title: Evia
project_text_1: A serene sanctuary situated on a pristine stretch of Saadiyat Island, Saadiyat Reserve is renowned for its white sandy beaches and protected wildlife. This newly developed community is also conveniently close to Saadiyat Island’s Cultural District, including the Louvre, offering residents an abundance of cultural experiences.

Evia holds special significance for our client, a builder by profession who is heavily invested in designing his family home for himself, his wife, and their three young children. With a clear vision and personal dedication to the design, collaborating with him has been a rewarding experience.
project_text_2: Evia’s exterior features elegant travertine cladding and a medium-sized garden, welcoming visitors through a double-height entrance. Inside, the standout feature is the Grand Room, a stunning double-height living area characterised by 9 meters of full-height glazing, which offers breathtaking views of the surrounding island.

What sets this home apart is its rear living spaces, which overlook a community park, providing an ideal recreational area to play and explore. Also located near the beach, Evia is ideally suited for this active young family, offering not only comfort, style, and functionality but also a home in which they can build memories that last a lifetime.

WEST LINKS.title: WEST LINKS
project_text_1: Transforming an unused parcel of land into a vibrant residential community, West Links was designed to cater to diverse family needs, offering a mix of semi-detached and stand-alone homes, including affordable housing, townhouses, and a signature home. Sitting adjacent to a renowned Scottish Golf Club, each property has been strategically positioned to maximise the spectacular golf course vistas and views of the historic town in the distance.

Inspired by a traditional Scottish longhouse, the modern design graciously incorporates local heritage and traditions. Each property, named after a Scottish tree, adds unique character and pays homage to indigenous trees, creating a contemporary neighbourhood with a distinctive Scottish identity.
project_text_2:
Reminiscent of Victorian styles, the entrances seamlessly integrate with the existing neighbourhood aesthetic. At the same time, the façades feature a sophisticated blend of Scottish Larch Cladding and Rheinzink, complemented by full glass gable ends that maximise natural light and panoramic vistas.

The development's layout ensures that every unit enjoys unobstructed views, enhancing the living experience with a sense of openness and connection to the natural surroundings. Whilst the interior features are tailored to individual preferences, the expansive exteriors invite residents to create their own outdoor havens.

Working in collaboration with local developers, West Links elevates the lifestyle of those who reside within, blending aesthetic appeal with practical functionality to create a community that offers modern comforts while still respecting Scottish roots.
project_type_set: 10 x 3-bedroom Affordable Units, 11 x 4-bedroom Townhouses, 2 x 3-bedroom Apartments

Orel.title: Orel
project_text_1: The Orel project is a perfect case study for rehabilitating, repurposing and redeveloping unused land, transforming a vacant parcel into a thriving agricultural farm that operates efficiently on a commercial scale while also providing tranquil spaces of serene beauty as a tourist destination. The objective from the outset was to establish an eco-farm that operates on a commercial scale while also providing facilities and accommodations for tourists.

In essence, Orel will cultivate sunflowers for oil extraction and, to enhance the land's viability, diversify with a variety of vegetable crops and an Orangery. Given the farm's stunning natural landscape, the owner decided to further develop the property offering by adding a guesthouse, ten standalone chalets, a greenhouse, a horse stable, a café, and tennis courts.
project_text_2: Revitalising the plot, these additions will offer visitors a range of engaging activities and experiences during their stay. The crowning feature of the project will be the construction of the owner's private villa, nestled within a serene forest and overlooking a picturesque man-made lake.
Each structure will be functional, aesthetically appealing to guests and, importantly, to the client, embodying the essence of farm life.
